Seeing Mitsuri’s alluring figure up close, Tanjiro feels completely uncomfortable. He couldn’t help but glance at her ample chest, but remembering his girlfriend Kanao, he shook his head and regained his composure. Tanjiro said he had forgotten he had business to attend to and left the hot spring early. Mitsuri was surprised to see Tanjiro leaving the hot spring and made a puzzling decision. She grabbed Tanjiro, trying to stop him from leaving. Tanjiro was shocked and asked himself why Mitsuri was doing this now. Her grip was strong; she undoubtedly possessed superhuman strength.

Then, Mitsuri suddenly bit Tanjiro’s ear lightly and began nibbling on it seductively. Tanjiro was instantly taken aback. Mitsuri then began licking Tanjiro’s face, leaving him deeply flustered and embarrassed. Finally, Mitsuri pressed Tanjiro’s face down and reached out to kiss him. Tanjiro was stunned. This woman, whom he barely knew, was trying to steal the first kiss he had saved for his girlfriend, Kanao. Before their lips could touch, Tanjiro pushed Mitsuri’s face away with his hand.

Mitsuri gently bit Tanjiro’s finger and sucked on it. Tanjiro’s nose began to bleed from the shock and excitement. Stunned by the events unfolding before his eyes, Tanjiro was momentarily distracted and was attacked by Mitsuri. The two of them sank into the pool. When they surfaced, it became clear that Mitsuri had stolen Tanjiro’s first kiss.
Tanjiro’s first kiss had been stolen by a beautiful woman he barely knew. Devastated, yet at the same time, as Mitsuri’s tongue slid inside his mouth and they engaged in a passionate kiss, Tanjiro was thrown into turmoil. When Tanjiro frantically tries to run away, Mitsuri quickly catches up to him and clings to his back, refusing to let go. Tanjiro hadn’t expected Mitsuri to be so heavy. With Mitsuri clinging to his back, Tanjiro slowly begins to walk. Mitsuri ties Tanjiro’s arms with rope, teases his erect penis with her voluptuous buttocks, and finally has unprotected sex with him, taking Tanjiro’s virginity.

It doesn’t take long for Mitsuri to skillfully guide Tanjiro to climax; without letting him pull out, she drives him to orgasm deep inside her. Late that night, Tanjiro heads back to the dormitory to sleep. Feeling down due to his current stressful situation, Tanjiro realizes that Zenitsu’s assumptions were completely wrong, and that the Love Pillar’s true nature is different from her appearance (though Zenitsu himself likely sees no issue with Mitsuri’s true face). Tanjiro hears a familiar voice and is surprised to find his girlfriend, Kanao, has come to say hello.

Shinobu Kocho had come to the Blacksmith Village to have new swords forged for her disciples. Kanao had also come to check on Tanjiro for that very reason. Tanjiro is overjoyed to see his girlfriend, and his momentary anxiety vanishes. Kanao then asks Tanjiro if he’s free tomorrow, hinting at a date. But their heartwarming reunion is short-lived; Mitsuri, the Love Pillar, appears and cuts in between them. Mitsuri grabs Kanao’s shoulder firmly and says, “Sorry, but I have plans with Tanjiro tomorrow,” then grabs Tanjiro’s hand and tries to drag him away by force. Kanao is taken aback. She wonders if something has happened between Tanjiro and Mitsuri. "She grabbed his shoulder so hard, and she was pretty forceful with Tanjiro, too. What on earth is going on?" 霧柱・無一郎とのほぼ一日の修行の後、炭治郎は里の温泉でくつろぐことにする。しかし、その安らぎは長くは続かず、恋柱・蜜璃が加わり、炭治郎はひどく落ち着かなくなる。蜜璃が男性に体をさらすことを気にしないという事実に炭治郎は驚き、恋愛関係でもない男性に体をさらすことを恥ずかしがらないほど、蜜璃は本当に純真なのだろうかと自問する。

炭治郎の初キスは、よく知らない美しい女性に奪われてしまった。打ちのめされると同時に、蜜璃の舌が口内を滑り、情熱的なキスを繰り広げる炭治郎は動揺する。蜜璃はすぐに炭治郎のペニスを勃起させ、それに気づき、しごき始め、ついにはフェラチオを始める。

その夜遅く、炭治郎は寝るために寮へ向かう。今のストレスフルな状況に落ち込んでいた炭治郎は、善逸の考えは大きく間違っていたこと、そして恋柱の正体は見た目とは違うことが判明する（善逸自身は蜜璃の素顔に何の問題も感じていないだろうが）。炭治郎は聞き覚えのある声を聞き、恋人のカナヲが挨拶に来たことに驚く。

胡蝶しのぶは弟子たちに新しい刀を仕立てるために刀鍛冶の里にやって来たのだった。カナオもその目的で炭治郎の様子を見に来たのだ。炭治郎は恋人の姿を見て喜び、一瞬の不安が消える。するとカナオは炭治郎に明日は空いているかと尋ね、デートの誘いをほのめかす。心温まる再会も束の間、恋柱・蜜璃が現れ、二人の間に割って入ってくる。蜜璃はカナオの肩を強く掴み、「ごめんね、明日は炭治郎と予定があるのに」と言い、炭治郎の手を掴んで無理やり連れ去ろうとする。カナオは驚く。炭治郎と蜜璃の間に何かあったのだろうかと訝しむ。「肩を強く掴んでいたし、炭治郎にもかなり強引だった。一体何が起こっているんだ？」と、恋人が恋柱に連れ去られる中、カナオの脳裏をよぎる。
